parties: Somaratna Ranatunga v. U.G. Wimalasena Somaratna Ranatunga v. U.G. Wimalasena View More
keywords: District Court dismissed a partition action for failure to establish adequate details regarding the original owner of the subject matter. The plaintiffs claimed the original owner was Hendrik Appuhamy, but their own deed identified three different original owners, creating serious confusion. Court upheld the dismissal, finding the District Court correctly declined to investigate title on the contradictory material. No costs awarded.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
